dishes.make_ahead: Fry the onions up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled and reheat. Boil and fry the pierogi on the night

steps.text: Slowly fry the onions in some of the butter over low heat until deep golden.
Boil the pierogi until they float, then drain well.
Fry the pierogi in the remaining butter in a large pan until crisp and golden on both sides.
Pile onto a platter, top with the onions and serve with sour cream and chives.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 week, keep in an airtight container

steps.text: Melt the butter with the honey and brown sugar, then toss the peanuts and chilli flakes through until coated.
Spread on a lined tray and bake at 170C, stirring every few minutes, until deep golden.
Sprinkle with sea salt while hot, then cool completely and break into clusters.

dishes.n: Cleveland Polish boy with fries and slaw
dishes.make_ahead: Make the slaw up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled. Bake the chips and grill the kielbasa on the night

steps.text: Bake the chips at 220C until crisp.
Toss the cabbage and carrot with the mayonnaise, vinegar and sugar for the slaw.
Score the kielbasa and grill, turning, until charred.
Split the rolls, lay a kielbasa in each, pile on hot chips, drizzle with barbecue sauce and top with slaw.

veg.n: Cleveland Polish boy with fries and slaw (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Shred the cabbage and grate the carrot up to 1 day ahead and dress the slaw up to 3 hours ahead, keep chilled. Bake the chips and grill the sausages on the night

steps.text: Bake the chips at 220C until crisp.
Toss the cabbage and carrot with the mayonnaise, vinegar and sugar for the slaw.
Score the vegetarian sausages, brush with the oil and grill, turning, until charred.
Split the rolls, lay a sausage in each, pile on hot chips, drizzle with barbecue sauce and top with slaw.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep covered at room temperature

ingredients.item: caster sugar, plus extra to sprinkle

steps.text: Drain the cherries, keeping some of the juice. Simmer the juice with the sugar and cornflour until thick, then stir in the cherries and a squeeze of lemon.
Line a 23cm pie dish with one pastry sheet and fill with the cherries.
Cut the other sheets into strips and weave a lattice over the top. Brush with egg and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake at 190C until golden.
Rest, then serve with ice cream.

dishes.n: Jobu's dark rum and ginger punch
dishes.make_ahead: Juice the limes up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled. Build each glass over ice to order

ingredients.item: dark rum, plus a small extra shot for Jobu

steps.text: Fill tall glasses with ice. Add the rum and lime juice to each glass.
Top with ginger beer and a couple of dashes of bitters. Stir once and garnish with a lime wedge.
Pour one extra small shot of rum into a glass and set it aside for Jobu before anyone drinks.

af.make_ahead: Steep and chill the spiced tea up to 2 days ahead in a covered jar in the fridge; juice the limes up to 1 day ahead. Build each glass to order

steps.text: Steep the tea bags in the boiling water for 4 minutes, lift out, stir in the molasses and vanilla and cool.
Fill tall glasses with ice. Add the spiced tea and lime juice to each glass.
Top with ginger beer, stir once and garnish with a lime wedge.
Pour one extra small shot of the spiced tea into a glass and set it aside for Jobu before anyone drinks.
